content: Claude Agent SDK (PyPI claude-agent-sdk) supports in-process MCP via @tool + create_sdk_mcp_server, hooks, and Agent Skills. opencode-agent-sdk is a drop-in replacement for claude_agent_sdk and is provider-agnostic (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/local). These define the abstraction-seam target: a thin port whose adapters map to Copilot SDK today and Claude/opencode later. Agent Skills is an OPEN cross-agent standard (SKILL.md in .github/skills, .claude/skills, ~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills) supported by Copilot CLI (GA ~2026) AND Claude SDK -> skills are portable across the seam.
